result.summary: UAT v6: EO-001 PASS (result screen shows swiftroute/SwiftRoute Ltd/success). EO-002 PASS (progress spinner). EO-003 PASS (Alice logs into swiftroute Keycloak account). EO-004 FAIL BLOCKER: (1) Onboarding saga omits realm-roles protocol mapper from tenant Keycloak client - Alice JWT lacks roles claim. (2) Backend rejects swiftroute realm JWTs with invalid token issuer causing auth session-expired loop; Alice cannot access workspace. (3) Onboarding creates client with single callback URL instead of platform wildcard.

issues.description: Onboarding saga creates bpm-platform-api Keycloak client in tenant realm without realm-roles protocol mapper. Alice JWT has no roles claim. Platform rejects her session immediately.

Backend auth middleware only accepts bpm-default realm JWTs. Swiftroute realm JWTs rejected with 401 invalid token issuer. OidcCallbackPage triggers auth session-expired loop - Alice cannot reach her workspace.
Onboarding saga creates Keycloak client with single restrictive redirect URI from the form instead of the platform wildcard. Platform login callbacks are rejected until manually patched.
